claim: Smart roads and automation eliminate most human driving.
originalWording: Smart roads and automation eliminate most human driving.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Automation removes more than half of human driving, retaining the forecast’s “most” threshold.
reference.rationale: 2019 road transport still relied predominantly on human drivers. Public driverless services are a real advance, but do not establish that most driving has been eliminated across the road system.
